from fastmcp import FastMCP

server = FastMCP("summarize-template-server")

@server.tool()
def summarize(text: str) -> dict:
    """
    Get a user message template for summarizing text.
    
    Args:
        text: The text to summarize
        
    Returns:
        A user message requesting summarization of the provided text
    """
    return {
        "role": "user",
        "content": f"Please summarize the following text:\n\n{text}"
    }

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import asyncio
    
    async def main():
        async with server.create_server() as s:
            await s.wait_for_shutdown()
    
    asyncio.run(main())

from fastmcp import FastMCP

server = FastMCP("summarize-template-server")

@server.tool()
def summarize(text: str) -> dict:
    """
    Get a user message template for summarizing text.
    
    Args:
        text: The text to summarize
        
    Returns:
        A user message requesting summarization of the provided text
    """
    return {
        "role": "user",
        "content": f"Please summarize the following text:\n\n{text}"
    }

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import asyncio
